record.title: Thread completeness
record.description: Earlier parts of the titled chat may not be available as exportable verbatim messages in this work environment; this indexes recoverable concepts and sources, not every hidden turn.

review.assessment: Recover a source inventory and mark inaccessible turns. A complete scan of 835 records cannot certify a complete conversation history.
review.claim_ceiling: Review and proposed experimental conditions; no new empirical acquisition or automatic scientific promotion.
